summary: Magic Empire Global filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $100,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares through Chaince Securities as sales agent. MEGL closed at $1.12 on September 28, 2026, and will pay a 3.5% agent commission plus a 1.0% non-accountable expense allowance. Shares trade on Nasdaq under MEGL within a dual-class structure (Class A one vote, Class B 100 votes). No escrow is used, and sales occur at prevailing market prices. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and Hong Kong/PRC regulatory overhang given the foreign-private-issuer status.
